
'''Takata Shrine''' (高田神社) refers to several Shinto shrines in Japan:

* {{ill|Takata Shrine (Inashiki)|ja|高田神社 (稲敷市)}} (たかだじんじゃ) - Located in Inashiki City, Ibaraki Prefecture.
* {{ill|Takada Shrine (Hakusan)|ja|髙田神社 (白山市)}} (たかだじんじゃ) - Located in Hakusan City, Ishikawa Prefecture.
* {{ill|Takata Shrine (Hida)|ja|高田神社 (飛騨市)}} (たかたじんじゃ) - Located in Hida City, Gifu Prefecture.
* {{ill|Takata Shrine (Oki Island)|ja|高田神社 (隠岐の島町)}} (たかたじんじゃ) - Located in Okinoshima Town, Oki District, Shimane Prefecture.
* {{ill|Takada Shrine (Maniwa)|ja|高田神社 (真庭市)|12=simple|13=User:Immanuelle/Takada Shrine (Maniwa)|comment=changed title based on wikidata|qid=Q134930888}} (たかだじんじゃ) - Located in Maniwa City, Okayama Prefecture.
* {{ill|Takata Shrine (Tsuyama)|ja|高田神社 (津山市)}} (たかたじんじゃ) - Located in Tsuyama City, Okayama Prefecture.
* {{ill|Takata Shrine (Matsuyama)|ja|高田神社 (松山市)}} (たかたじんじゃ) - Located in Matsuyama City, Ehime Prefecture.
* {{ill|Takata Shrine (Itoshima)|ja|高田神社 (糸島市)}} (たかたじんじゃ) - Located in Itoshima City, Fukuoka Prefecture.
